## Relationships

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/gilbert-blythe--rhoda-allonby.md)

[Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) acts as the local medical professional who manages health treatments, such as insisting that [Anne](../character/anne.md) retain hired help to recover her strength. In his practice, he feels a strong moral and medical obligation to propose life-altering treatments to patients and their families, even when others advise him to leave well enough alone. Rhoda Allonby's connection to [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) is defined by a medical experiment through which she was saved.

- Saved by — medical experiment  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 29 GILBERT AND ANNE DISAGREE P22](../source/v04-c29.md#nw-v04-c29-p0022)</sub>
